overview_description.description:
Habit Food Personalized provides personalized nutrition solutions. It offers a do-it-yourself kit that enables users to collect personal bio-data; analyzes DNA and measures levels of nutritional biomarkers in the blood; identifies habit type and tells which food and nutrients suit for users; provides insights through registered dietitians, as well as wellness guidance, goal setting and accountability, and ongoing support; delivers specific nutrition diet to user’s doorstep; and shares goals with like-minded and like-bodied wellness-seekers through its mobile application. 

Neil Grimmer founded Habit Food Personalized in 2015. It has its headquarters in Oakland in California.

product.name: Personalized Nutrition Guidance
product.description: A service providing tailored nutrition advice based on individual lifestyle, preferences, and health goals to support healthier eating habits.

product.name: Healthy Eating Habit Development
product.description: A service focused on helping individuals build and maintain consistent healthy eating routines through practical strategies and habit formation techniques.

product.name: Mental Health Nutrition Support
product.description: A service that educates on the impact of nutrition on mental well-being and recommends foods that support mood and cognitive function.

product.name: Meal Planning and Preparation Assistance
product.description: A service offering practical tips and strategies for planning and preparing balanced meals and snacks to facilitate healthy eating.

product.name: Behavioral Change and Support Strategies
product.description: A service providing psychological insights and practical methods to overcome barriers to healthy eating and sustain dietary changes.
